task.description: REWORK 1/3. handoffs/WF03-ISS0736-20260921/step-02b-code-design-validator.json FAILED the previous design with exactly one BLOCKER (read its result.summary in full for the citation): GroupsPage.tsx's member-removal action does not actually work today -- web/src/api/identity.ts's removeMembers discards userIds and calls DELETE /api/v1/admin/groups/${id}/members with no user_id in the path, and no backend route matches that shape (real route is mounted at /identity per api_pipeline.ex:141, e.g. /api/v1/identity/groups/:id/members/:user_id). Every other part of the previous design (auth_pipeline.ex insertion point, users.status check, group_members/tenant_role live-role query, RoleRegistry non-coupling, AC3 renderer-contract claim, AC2's deactivation half via UserDetailPage.tsx) was independently re-verified correct by the validator and needs NO rework -- keep those sections as they are, do not rewrite what already passed. Fix only the GUI-reachability gap for role revocation: design the actual web/ fix needed to make GroupsPage.tsx's member-removal button call the real, correct backend endpoint (correct path/method matching lib/letflow/routers/identity.ex's real route, correct user_id threading instead of being discarded) so it becomes a genuinely working GUI path that removes a user from a group / revokes a role, backed by the new live per-request check from the unchanged half of this design. Update lib/letflow/design/req378-oidc-live-revocation-check.md in place -- amend the AC2 section, leave the rest.

result.summary: Amended lib/letflow/design/req378-oidc-live-revocation-check.md §4 in place (added §4.1), leaving §§0-3/5-10 unchanged, to fix the single BLOCKER from step-02b's FAIL. Independently re-verified against current source (not the previous design's own assertion): web/src/api/identity.ts:55-58's removeMembers(id, userIds) discards userIds and calls client.delete(`/api/v1/admin/groups/${id}/members`), and no backend route matches that path -- confirmed via lib/letflow/plugs/api_pipeline.ex:141 (forward("/identity", to: Letflow.Routers.Identity); no /admin/groups mount exists anywhere in api_pipeline.ex or router.ex) and lib/letflow/routers/identity.ex:182 (authz_delete "/groups/:id/members/:user_id", :GroupsManage -> handle_remove_member/4), so the real, only matching route is DELETE /api/v1/identity/groups/:id/members/:user_id -- a single-member route, not a batch one. Fix design (signatures only, no implementation bodies): (1) web/src/api/identity.ts groupsApi.removeMembers signature changes from (id: string, userIds: string[]) discarding its argument to (id: string, userId: string) => Promise<void>, calling client.delete(`/api/v1/identity/groups/${id}/members/${userId}`) -- userId now threaded through the URL path, matching client.delete's no-body signature (client.ts:250-252) and the backend's conn.params["user_id"] read; (2) web/src/pages/admin/GroupsPage.tsx's removeMember mutation (line 85-86) mutationFn changes from groupsApi.removeMembers(id, [userId]) to groupsApi.removeMembers(id, userId) -- no other line changes, the button's mutate() call site at line 234 already passed the correct {groupId, userId} shape into the mutation, the bug was entirely inside mutationFn/identity.ts. Explicitly scoped out (flagged in the doc, not silently fixed): groupsApi.addMembers/.list/.get/.update/.delete/.members share the same nonexistent /api/v1/admin/groups/... prefix bug, independently confirmed by the same api_pipeline.ex/router.ex read, but REQ-378/this handoff's task.description/step-02b's BLOCKER are all scoped to the revocation write path only -- flagged for ORCH/REQ-ANALYST as a separate follow-up requirement, not bundled in here. Deactivation half of AC2 (UserDetailPage.tsx) left completely unchanged, as instructed -- it was independently re-verified correct by step-02b and is out of this rework's scope.
result.next_action: Route to CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR for re-gate (step-02b-2 or equivalent next handoff): re-verify amended §4/§4.1 against actual web/ and lib/letflow/routers/identity.ex source, confirm the corrected removeMembers signature/call site now genuinely reaches the real backend route, and confirm no other section was altered.
